stem: A large rock is motionless on a flat sidewalk. Which statement best explains why the rock remains motionless?

options.label: F
options.text: There are no forces acting on the rock.

options.label: G
options.text: The only force acting on the rock is directed toward the sidewalk.

options.label: H
options.text: The forces acting on the rock are all balanced.

options.label: J
options.text: The sidewalk exerts an unbalanced force on the rock.
